risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/platform/metrics/**, entry.ts, payout/index.ts export only, infra/monitoring/rules/couli-fund.yaml): worker-exported gauges couli_auto_payout_daily_total_fen / couli_auto_payout_daily_cap_fen per app_id and two couli-fund rules (total / cap >= 0.8 warning, >= 1 critical, fund 'true', for 5m), closing B2-11c Codex money S1-2 moved here by D10-389. Read-only SQL over app.withdrawals and app.config_items; total uses B2-11c's ⑨ basis (review_mode auto, status not REJECTED / FAILED, reviewed_at on the injected Clock's +08:00 accounting day via packages/domain); the cap comes from payout's own autoPayoutConfigOf injected by entry.ts (D10-393 (c)): a missing or malformed cap is the default B2-11c executes with, no copy in platform, and platform/** does not import payout. No writes, no database clock, amounts are integer fen. Rule tests by fresh independent Claude runs (approvals #36), three test(spec) rounds; the frozen rules.test.ts whitelist change went in first as B1-01zzpz (#1728, D10-399), red PASS on the rebased spec commit (16 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 subagents in two runs (run 2 after the default-cap test). verify:fast in the test-machine container exit 0. Full verify on the test machine (verify/1): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it; every fund-alerts test passed, including collect.int and default-cap.int; recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check.
